metaTitle: Custom With Wheels Headphones | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom with wheels headphones for your team. Perfect for travel or classroom use. Call Perfect Imprints for bulk pricing.
introHtml: With wheels headphones combine the portability of a wheeled carrying case with the functionality of a headphone set, making them ideal for schools, libraries, or corporate training rooms where multiple users need to share a clean, organized audio solution. The built-in wheels let you roll a complete set from room to room without lifting heavy boxes. Choose single-ear or over-ear models, and add your logo via pad print or screen print for a professional look that keeps your brand present wherever listening happens.
heroAltText: Custom with wheels headphones in a wheeled carrying case for schools and offices
